### Bible Pathways 05/27/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-27-or-2002-1133458.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 23:16
Points:
- Unholy alliances with idolaters can bring destructive, multi-generational consequences to God's people.
- Forsaking the Lord leads to spiritual compromise, moral ruin, and inevitable divine judgment.
- God sovereignly protects His covenant promises, preserving the lineage of David despite violent opposition.
- Believers must heed biblical warnings against intimate partnerships with unbelievers to maintain godly devotion.
